narrative:
No non-compliant items were identified on this inspection. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the 
applicant. 
 
Each applicant for a license must demonstrate that his location and any animals, facilities, vehicles, equipment, or other 
locations used or intended for use in the business comply with the Animal Welfare Act (AWA) and the regulations and 
standards. The purpose of this inspection is to help USDA ascertain your compliance with the AWA and regulations and 
standards. 
 
We will send a copy of your new license to you within 30 days, unless additional review is required. You do not need to 
take further action at this time. If you have not received your license within 30 days, please contact the USDA at 970-494-
7478. 
 
Conducting regulated activities prior to issuance of a valid USDA license is a violation of the Animal Welfare Act.
